development_findings: Raw train trajectories can contaminate decisions with source-variation entities; source targets are now abstracted before prompting.
Locked intent must constrain candidate actions, rather than relying only on a prompt instruction.
Zero-reward repeated state-action transitions are logged and removed to control avoidable rework; wait1 remains repeatable.
B4 and IPER development failures remain algorithm outcomes and are not grounds for choosing a model from formal test results.
freeze_rule: Run the preregistered extended development pilot, verify parsing, action validity, latency, cost and trajectory stability, then freeze settings before any formal test run.
fairness_rule: Use the same requested model, endpoint, decoding settings and output budget for B0, B1, B2, B4 and IPER-RAG.
selection_rule: Select on operational development criteria only; do not inspect formal test outcomes when choosing or changing the model.
